            <title><![CDATA[Trump says he's banning 3 outlets from White House in his latest attack on press freedom]]></title>
            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/trump-says-hes-banning-3-outlets-from-white-house-in-his-latest-attack-on-press-freedom</link>
            <description><![CDATA[President Donald Trump says he is banning three major news outlets, CNN, MS NOW and Politico, from the White House due to what he called "unfavorable coverage." Trump didn't provide details on how the ban would be implemented, but warned he might bar other media outlets as well. White House Correspondent Liz Landers reports on the administration's latest test of First Amendment protections.]]></description>

            <description><![CDATA[In our news wrap Friday, California Gov. Gavin Newsom signed an executive order that aims to speed up safety measures for AI, including a possible 'kill switch' for advanced models, President Trump announced that all 50 states will participate in a new Medicaid drug pricing program and Russians are voting in the country's first parliamentary elections since its invasion of Ukraine in 2022.]]></description>

            <title><![CDATA['Shadow surge' pushes immigration arrests to highs as Trump administration shifts tactics]]></title>
            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/shadow-surge-pushes-immigration-arrests-to-highs-as-trump-administration-shifts-tactics</link>
            <description><![CDATA[Less than a year ago, aggressive immigration raids were drawing headlines and sparking protests. But recently, the Trump administration has shifted its approach. Instead of relying as heavily on high-profile operations, federal immigration authorities are working with state and local police.             <title><![CDATA[U.S.-Saudi nuclear power deal faces pushback over potential weapons risks]]></title>
            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/u-s-saudi-nuclear-power-deal-faces-pushback-over-potential-weapons-risks</link>
            <description><![CDATA[This week, Democratic representatives introduced a resolution to block the Trump administration's new civilian nuclear agreement with Saudi Arabia. The deal paves the way for the U.S. to help Saudi Arabia build a nuclear power program for peaceful purposes.             <title><![CDATA[What's making the Texas Senate race so competitive]]></title>
            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/whats-making-the-texas-senate-race-so-competitive</link>
            <description><![CDATA[The Texas flag shares America's red, white and blue. But its politics have run Republican red for thirty years.             <title><![CDATA['The Last Free Women' follows 4 Afghans rebuilding their lives after escaping the Taliban]]></title>
            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/the-last-free-women-follows-4-afghans-rebuilding-their-lives-after-escaping-the-taliban</link>
            <description><![CDATA[When the Taliban swept back into Kabul in 2021, millions of Afghans suddenly faced an uncertain and dangerous future. Among them were two young sisters whose ambitions to study medicine and law were threatened. Their escape and the lives they built afterward are at the heart of the new book, "The Last Free Women."
